title: Record that the channel touches every target before every source
body:
## Summary
- In the 4,058-event channel, no event names both an X register and a Y register. Every target is first touched by index 410, and every source is first touched at or after index 488.
- All 208 published flags therefore begin their matched target before their source. None share an event.
- Flag 0 is source X0 and target Y34. X0 starts at index 591 on frame [232] with coefficients ±2. Y34 starts at index 129 with coefficients ±1/4. Neither register is restored. There is no new exponent.
